title: struthiopteris dura
intro: Struthiopteris dura, commonly known as the Australian fern, is a species of fern native to Australia. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Struthiopteris dura include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
